messages:
marta: FYI, Acme's payment flow started failing after last assistant tweak. Function calls to charge_card returning schema errors and a bunch of converted-string amounts.
jamal: Can you paste a log + request_id? is this only on one tenant?
marta: request_id=01F8ZQ9... snippet:
```
ERROR: function 'charge_card' validation failed
expected: {amount: number, currency: string, metadata: object}
received: {amount: "10.00", currency: "USD", note: "priority"}
```
Only for Acme so far (dedicated). Customer says payments intermittently fail and sometimes succeed with older model.
ingrid: Customer reported billing failures and a spike in latency when retries happen. They're escalated to P1.
sophia: Quick hypothesis: few-shot examples in the system prompt include an example charge with amount as a string ("10.00") which upstream model picks up and emits. That would cause the function args to violate our schema. Did the assistant change default examples in v3?
marta: yes, last deploy included updated examples to clarify UX. I can repro locally by sending the system prompt + examples. repro curl:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"assistant-v3\",\"messages\":[{\"role\":\"system\",\"content\":\"You are a billing assistant. Examples:\\nExample: {\\\"amount\\\": \\\"10.00\\\", \\\"currency\\\": \\\"USD\\\"}\"},{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"Charge customer 10 dollars\"}] , \"functions\":[{\"name\":\"charge_card\",\"parameters\":{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"amount\":{\"type\":\"number\"},\"currency\":{\"type\":\"string\"}},\"required\":[\"amount\",\"currency\"]}}] }'
```
response shows function_call args with amount as string.
jamal: We should not rely on examples bleeding into structured output. Short-term: add a validation/coercion layer that accepts numeric strings and casts to numbers for well-formed digits. Also return a clear error code so customers can retry deterministically.
sophia: Agreed. I'll run a small patch that attempts safe cast for numeric fields during function argument parsing and add a regression test with 2k prompt variants. If it looks good, we can hotfix to staging and then prod for Acme only.
ops-bot: deploy queued for eng-runtime-hotfix (job 7892) :hourglass_flowing_sand:
marta: For customer comms, propose: 1) enable tenant fallback to model v2 (already working), 2) apply server-side safe-coerce, 3) follow up with a permanent fix to our prompt templates to avoid example forms that look like literal JSON values.
ingrid: ETA to hotfix?
sophia: I'll have a staging build in ~90m, prod rollout after verification in ~3h if tests pass. Adding @jamal for schema validation tweaks.
jamal: I'll submit a PR to parsing-lib to tolerant-coerce numeric-strings -> numbers and add a unit test. If approved, I can cut the hotfix immediately.
marta: Customer update prepared: "We've identified the cause (example values in assistant examples sometimes cause stringified numbers). We're rolling a tenant-scoped fix and will follow with a template update. Temporary rollback available if needed." Want me to send?
ingrid: Send it. I'll include a 4hr status cadence and the remediation plan. :thumbsup:
sophia: After hotfix, follow-up action items: (a) scan prompt templates for more examples that might be mis-typed, (b) add a linter to repo that flags JSON-like examples with quotes around numeric-only fields, (c) add an eval to Redwood Optimize to surface these regressions.
marta: assigning: @sophia (hotfix + eval), @jamal (parser PR), @ingrid (customer comms). Marking thread P1.
ops-bot: incident created INC-20260317-45, priority=P1 :rotating_light:
jamal: noted, will ping eng-runtime on call if rollout shows anomalies.
marta: thanks all. will post logs + confirmation once prod patch is live. :white_check_mark:
